name: estimateEnergyWh
summary: Estimate the energy (Wh) an LLM call costs from the model name and its input/output token split: classify the model into a tier by name pattern, then apply per-1k-token coefficients. Directional, not metered — unknown hosted models fall to the mid tier rather than zero, so an unrecognised model is never free. Harvested from the Fleet page's cost panel (#3462).
